notes.title: Making it in Unreal: join Burnout devs for a spot of target shooting in Lethal VR
notes.notes:
When a bunch of former Burnout leads started work on Lethal VR this summer, they called up the NRA. Not the American branch, who were rather busy at the time buying TV ads for the new president-elect, but the Bisley-based UK governing body of full bore rifle and pistol shooting.

"How exciting are shooting competitions?," they asked the man who answered the phone. "What happens?"

Read more: the best PC first-person shooters.

For those of us who don't know, it turns out to be a tightly controlled experience. It's about lying prone with a rifle and shooting a distant bullseye. It's about waiting for a man stood a very long way away to hold up a flag indicating whether you hit or missed.

Read the rest of the story...

notes.title: Team17 - 100th Game Celebration
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32941731/ce201387f7d4e82ee6ad0624c277acea9e6a229a.png[/img]

With the release of PLANET ALPHA on 4th September 2018, Team17 will have released 100 games! This landmark includes games developed and/or published here at Team17, ranging from our early Amiga days with the likes of Alien Breed, Body Blows and Project X, through the explosion in popularity of the Worms series, our work-for-hire period on franchises like Lemmings and Leisure Suit Larry right through to the modern age and our indie games label featuring The Escapists, Overcooked and Yooka-Laylee!

https://youtu.be/CfGBMGPl_5s

Our celebration begins today with the retrospective video above, as well as a new trailer for [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/485030/PLANET_ALPHA/]PLANET ALPHA[/url], available to pre-order now with a 10% discount!

There's more to come too! Keep an eye on Team17's [url=https://www.facebook.com/Team17/]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/Team17Ltd]Twitter[/url] channels for more activities throughout the year, including behind-the-scenes retropspectives, competitions and fun with friends!

What's your favourite Team17 game of all time? Why not join us in the official [url=discord.gg/team17]Team17 Discord[/url] server and let us know?

notes.title: UPDATED: Global and Friends Leaderboards Live for all Players
notes.notes:
Good Morning Recruits!

The current temperature is 110 degrees.

The Chief Instructor of​ ​Lethal VR​ ​Weapons Training has asked me to inform you of an update which has been released for ​all​ ​Vive Lethal VR Recruits​.

This update adds Global ​and Friends ​Leaderboards into each training Simulation. 

Previous bests will be uploaded automatically.

Your reaction times, quickdraw speed and simulation points will be compared and shared with all Recruits globally.

The update includes the following:
[list]
[*]Previous high scores will be uploaded to the new leaderboards allowing for immediate Global competition
[*]A 'Leaderboard' option will now appear in the Main Menu - Recruits can toggle between Global, Friends and Local leaderboards for each Simulation.
[*]​In 'Settings' ​Recruits can ​select which Leaderboard (Global, Friends or Local) they want displayed on the Simulation Introduction and Results screens.
[*]This update also enhances the Settings to enable players to choose whether they are left or right handed and also to adjust their Gun Angle, a requested feature for expert play.

[/list]

notes.notes:

[h1][b]Hi recruits![/b][/h1]

We just wanted to thank you for all your support and feedback after the launch of Lethal VR! 
We’ve been listening to all your comments, suggestions and requests in the forums and on our social channels, and I’m pleased to announce that we are working on adding global leaderboards! We don’t have a planned release date for the update yet, but it is something we are working on, so keep your eyes open for more information on the forums and news page in the future.

[b]Keep training hard recruits, and thank you again![/b]

notes.title: Lethal VR, out now for HTC Vive!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26630230/f5dfef8943af4425bd40ec14fb0ab4ab31492826.gif[/img]

Hone your skills in our fast FBI training simulation, where a variety of weapons including dual handguns, throwing knives and ninja stars are at your disposal! Inspired by classic arcade shooters and enhanced with immersive VR technology, Lethal VR brings a brand new experience to the familiar arcade shooter style genre.

https://youtu.be/CRIH9ygsdZI

Built from the ground up for the HTC Vive, and with over 30 training missions to complete and master, Lethal VR is a true 360 room-scale weapons training experience. 

Don’t forget to check out the forums, we want your first impressions and obviously your high scores too! Got a favourite weapon? Let us know in the discussions! 
http://steamcommunity.com/app/532270/discussions/

Also while you’re chasing the high scores you can try and collect the full set of trading cards!

There will be a 20% launch discount so you can get training for less! 

http://store.steampowered.com/app/532270/


[b]Enjoy yourselves recruits, and good luck![/b]

notes.title: Lethal VR
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26630230/957ffe32d55321ce2782db2ca322cad17bc772dd.gif[/img]

We’re super excited to announce Lethal VR!

Lethal VR is an immersive Virtual Reality weapons experience for the PlayStation VR brought to you from Three Fields Entertainment, creators of Burnout, BLACK and Dangerous Golf.

Step into the shoes of an FBI Recruit and be tested in a series of weapons simulation exercises, featuring a variety of small weapons. After each challenge you will be graded on your performance. Do you have what it takes to earn a Lethal rating?

Your abilities will be tested in 30 different challenges spread across 5 tiers of weapons simulation. You will need to demonstrate speed, precision, deadly accuracy and the ability to remain calm under pressure.

[h1] Check out the trailer [/h1]
https://youtu.be/u74_AK1JTz4

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26630230/f5dfef8943af4425bd40ec14fb0ab4ab31492826.gif[/img]

[h1]
We want to know what [b]you[/b] think of Lethal VR so stop by the forum![/h1]
